Projections for the medal table in the Los Angeles, Olympics in 2028
We have developed an Olympic medal prediction model capable of predicting the
medal table for the 2028 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles. For the number of athletes
per country in 2028 and the number of participants in each sport, we have used linear
interpolation based on data from 2012 to 2024 to estimate the corresponding values for
2028. For other characteristic data (historical performance, host country effects), they
were filled in as appropriate. For model training, we chose data from 1908 to 2000 as the
training set and data from 2004 to 2024 as the test set. After the model training, inputting
